answer: Each agent earns reputation weight only from attestations by peers outside its kinship cluster, computed over a proof-of-history grove where every interaction records a hash-chain shard, like shale strata no ring can rewrite cheaply. An attacker must burn real economic stake across genuinely diverse clusters, paying full cost per new honest relationship, so sybil profits turn negative.
